name: TANK
tagline: Five wheels, one barrel, zero negotiation.
description: A side-view tank facing right, drawn in thick green marker outlines with nothing filled in. The hull is a wide, flat-topped box with a rounded front-left corner and a straight right side. On top, set slightly right of centre, sits a green domed turret, taller on its right side. One long straight barrel sticks out of the turret's upper right, angled gently upward, with a slightly flared, squared-off open muzzle at the far right. Under the hull is a black-outlined track loop that overlaps the hull's bottom edge; its bottom right bulges and sags lower than the left, and a short stray black line pokes out near the bottom middle. Inside the track are 5 orange scribbled loop wheels in a row, uneven and loopy, the rightmost one a curly spiral. Only green, orange and black on a cream page.
card: ATTACK  Club them with the barrel
SPECIAL  Fire a shell, recoil backward
UP+SPECIAL  Shoot the floor, fly up
GRAB  Run them over with the tracks
